_comment: Copy to reference.json (git-ignored) and edit, then run: python scripts/load_reference.py --dry-run. Entries here OVERWRITE existing rows; nothing is ever deleted. A section left out falls back to the script's built-in defaults (insert-only). Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Prices are illustrative list prices: check your GitHub contract and https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing
_default_seat_plan: Seat plan for members derived from real turns (and config members without seat_plan_id).
_default_team: Team for members whose turns carry no team_id (or more than one).
_seat_plans: Subscription cost per seat and month. included_ai_credits = monthly AI credit pool per seat; included_premium_requests / overage_per_premium_request_usd = legacy premium-request model.
_model_prices: USD per 1M tokens (API-equivalent cost) + legacy premium multiplier. A model ending in '*' is a prefix: exact match wins, else the longest prefix.
_teams: Display names for team ids (team_id comes from the Copilot resource attribute in LangSmith).
_projects: Projects; repos are attached to them through repo_mappings.
_repo_mappings: repo may be 'owner/name' or any remote URL (normalized to lowercase owner/name; Azure DevOps -> org/repo).
_members: user_name must match the user name in LangSmith turns. Omitted fields keep the stored value (or the defaults above).
